excluded.runs/stage0-support/cache.sqlite: worker-request cache; never read by payoff_support.load_support_surface — only its accounting counts, which are fields of surface/manifest.json and are verified there

purpose: Evidence-preservation companion to the immutable B diagnostic success archive (204_s section 10 / 206_s / 208_s): the exact pinned Stage-0 payoff-surface input bytes the diagnostic verifier reads, which live under the untracked runs/ directory and are otherwise absent from a clean checkout. The archive itself is unchanged.
restore_instructions: From a clean checkout: copy each file to its restore_path, creating runs/stage0-support/ and runs/stage0-support/traces/traces/ as needed. Then the full verifier runs via the committed CLI (tasks.conductor.stage1_b_diagnostic report) against the committed archive; payoff_support.load_support_surface re-scores every payoff from the stored terminal values against regenerated gold and validates every content hash above.
